findings.summary: Single-use computed predicate can be inlined.
findings.consequence: The shell carries an extra reactive binding for a direct route-path comparison, so readers have to trace `isStartPage` before seeing that the academy logo is only gated on the root route.
findings.evidence: Line 13 defines `computed(() => route.path === "/")`; `rg` shows the binding is only consumed once, by `LazyHomeAcademyLogo` in this same component. The wrapper does not enforce normalization, SSR isolation, or a shared start-page policy.
findings.recommendation: Delete `isStartPage` and use `route.path === "/"` directly at the `LazyHomeAcademyLogo` `v-if`, or keep the binding only if another start-page policy is added.
